drive.name: Sampling distributions: my notes
drive.text:
# Key ideas

A sampling distribution describes how a statistic varies from sample to sample.

# Standard error

The standard error shrinks as the sample size grows, so larger samples give tighter estimates of the population mean.

# Open question

I am not sure why skewed populations still give bell shaped sample means.
